title: Guidance Bends the Trajectory
tagline: Guidance steers diffusion sampling toward a class — and trades diversity for fidelity
summary: A diffusion model samples by running a learned reverse process that walks noise back toward the data. Unconditionally, samples spread across every mode. A guidance term adds a pull toward a chosen class, over-weighted by a scale w: at w=0 the trajectories scatter over all modes, and as w grows they bend hard toward the target class but collapse onto its centre. Pick a target, sweep the guidance scale, and press Run to watch the reverse trajectories animate while the fidelity and diversity numbers move in opposite directions.
highlights: Watch an animated reverse-diffusion process walk a batch of noisy samples back toward three data modes.
Set the guidance scale from 0 (unconditional, all modes) upward and see trajectories bend toward the chosen class.
Push the scale high and watch samples collapse onto the target class centre — mode collapse in action.
Read the fidelity and diversity numbers move in opposite directions as you turn the guidance knob.
Connect the toy to real systems: the same knob is classifier-free guidance in Stable Diffusion and Imagen.
